description:
LiveX AI · Backend Software Engineer
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, on-site · Department: Engineering
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/backend-software-engineer (posted May 27, 2026)


ABOUT THE ROLE

LiveX AI is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to develop and enhance the backend systems behind its AI platform, which provides real-time, personalized customer engagement, faster problem-solving, and proactive support. Design scalable, efficient infrastructure for AI agents so they deliver VIP-level service in every customer interaction.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services that power AI-driven customer engagement solutions.

 - Implement and integrate AI models, including LLM technologies, to deliver personalized, seamless customer interactions.

 - Optimize backend systems for performance, scalability, and reliability to support real-time AI-driven workflows.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, sales, product) to refine AI-powered solutions.

 - Stay current on emerging AI and backend technologies; propose and implement innovative solutions.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience.

 - Proven expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or similar advanced AI technologies.

 - Hands-on experience with open-source LLM frameworks and tools, including deployment and optimization.

 - Proficiency with cloud services (especially Google Cloud) and API development.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and Go; clean, efficient, maintainable code.

 - Passion for using technology to drive business innovation and improve customer experiences.

 - Comfortable in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments; proactive, adaptable.

 - Fast learner with a startup mentality; takes initiative in a dynamic, fast-paced team.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with modern AI voice agent systems (strong plus).


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Work with a groundbreaking AI technology company in a collaborative, innovative, dynamic environment.

 - Competitive salary and benefits package; career growth in a rapidly expanding sector.


COMPENSATION

Not specified ("competitive salary and benefits package").


HOW TO APPLY (ORIGINAL POSTING)

Email career@livex.ai with subject "Candidate Application - Backend Software Engineer"; include resume, a cover letter explaining fit, and any relevant portfolio items.
